title: Finitely presented module tests for universal acyclicity imply K-flatness
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $E^\bullet$ an arbitrary cochain complex of $A$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For an $A$-module $M$, write $M[0]$ for the complex equal to $M$ in degree zero and zero elsewhere, and use the direct-sum total tensor complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], specialized to ordinary modules. Suppose $\operatorname{Tot}(E^\bullet\otimes_A M[0])$ is acyclic for every finitely presented $A$-module $M$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. Then $E^\bullet$ is K-flat [def-pc-module-kflat-complex]. No boundedness or flatness of its individual terms is assumed.
